resources.resource_name: Blossom Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Blossom model report identifies MODFLOW-NWT; this is not interchangeable with MODFLOW-2005.

resources.resource_name: Carrizo-Wilcox Aquifer (northern portion) GAM (version 3.01) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains the model run README specifying MODFLOW 6 version 6.0.5 (mf6.exe) for the northern Carrizo-Wilcox model.

resources.resource_name: Carrizo-Wilcox Aquifer (southern portion) GAM (version 3.1) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN landing metadata says the southern Carrizo-Wilcox model was developed using MODFLOW 6; archive/release confirmation remains required.

resources.resource_name: Carrizo-Wilcox Aquifer (central portion) GAM (version 3.02) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Explicit CKAN modflow_variant=modflow-usg extra on the live package; requires a distinct MINT contract.

resources.resource_name: Edwards (BFZ) Aquifer (Barton Springs Segment) GAM — Model and source data
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN resource abstract identifies MODFLOW-2000 for Barton Springs.

resources.resource_name: Edwards (BFZ) Aquifer (Northern Segment) GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN resource abstract identifies MODFLOW-USG beta; requires a distinct MINT contract.

resources.resource_name: Edwards (BFZ) Aquifer (San Antonio Segment) GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN package identifies GWSIM as the TWDB-maintained alternative; do not map it to MODFLOW.

resources.resource_name: Edwards-Trinity (Plateau) and Pecos Valley aquifers GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Official Edwards-Trinity alternative page distinguishes an updated MODFLOW-2000 model from the original MODFLOW-96; release-to-archive correspondence still needs confirmation.

resources.resource_name: Gulf Coast Aquifer System (central and southern portions) GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN resource abstract identifies MODFLOW-USG; requires a distinct MINT contract.

resources.resource_name: Gulf Coast Aquifer System (northern portion) GAM (version 4.1) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN resource abstract identifies MODFLOW 6 for the northern Gulf Coast archive.

resources.resource_name: High Plains Aquifer System GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: High Plains numerical report identifies MODFLOW-NWT; this is not interchangeable with MODFLOW-2005.

resources.resource_name: Capitan Reef Complex Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: The live CKAN package exposes mf2005.nam and mf2005.in alongside the Capitan archive, directly identifying the executable family.

resources.resource_name: Lipan Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: TWDB GAM run report identifies the Lipan model as MODFLOW-96.

resources.resource_name: Nacatoch Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Nacatoch numerical model report identifies MODFLOW-2000.

resources.resource_name: Trinity (northern portion) and Woodbine aquifers GAM (version 3.01) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Explicit CKAN modflow_variant=modflow6 extra on the live package.

resources.resource_name: Seymour and Blaine GAM — Model Files archive
resources.evidence_basis: Live CKAN resource abstract identifies this unversioned Seymour archive as native MODFLOW-2000.

resources.resource_name: Seymour and Blaine Aquifers GAM (v2.01) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Official TWDB Seymour/Blaine page identifies v2.01 as coded using MODFLOW 6.

resources.resource_name: Trinity Aquifer (southern portion) GAM (version 3.01) — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Explicit CKAN modflow_variant=modflow-96 extra on the live package; official TWDB model page identifies the release.

resources.resource_name: Bone Spring-Victorio Peak Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Bone Spring-Victorio Peak report identifies MODFLOW-2000.

resources.resource_name: Brazos River Alluvium Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: The remote BRAA101_01_Model_Report.zipx member directory contains Model_and_Utilities/bin/mfusg-beta.exe and a README referring to importing USG into GWV.

resources.resource_name: Cross Timbers Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Cross Timbers SAF summary identifies MODFLOW-6.

resources.resource_name: GMA 16 groundwater flow model — Model
resources.evidence_basis: GMA16 model report identifies MODFLOW-2000.

resources.resource_name: Hueco Bolsons Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains mf96hueco.exe beside the Hueco steady-state and transient namefiles.

resources.resource_name: Mesilla Bolsons Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains mf96canu.exe beside the Mesilla MODFLOW namefiles.

resources.resource_name: Igneous and West Texas Bolsons (Wild Horse Flat, Michigan Flat, Ryan Flat, and Lobo Flat) aquifers GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains Modflw96v.exe and the directory README explicitly identifies MODFLOW-96 ASCII array format and the USGS MODFLOW-96 executable.

resources.resource_name: Kinney County model — Model
resources.evidence_basis: The official Kinney County Groundwater Flow Model report identifies the new model as USGS MODFLOW-2000 Version 1.19.01, released in 2010.

resources.resource_name: Llano Uplift Aquifer System GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains MFUSGs.exe and the Llano input directory is explicitly named modflow-usg.

resources.resource_name: Lower Rio Grande Valley transport model — Model
resources.evidence_basis: The remote lrgv1.01_model_files.zipx member directory contains USGs_lrgv.exe in the calibrated flow and density-dependent model directories.

resources.resource_name: West Texas Bolsons (Presidio and Redford Bolsons) Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains the Presidio/Redford README, which instructs users to run the model with the USGS mf2k executable.

resources.resource_name: Rustler Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains the Rustler README, which identifies MODFLOW-NWT executables in the calibrated, official 200 AFY, and low-Kv model directories.

resources.resource_name: Seymour Aquifer in Haskell, Knox, and Baylor counties GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: The official Seymour Haskell/Knox/Baylor GAM report identifies the flow model as USGS MODFLOW-2000.

resources.resource_name: West Texas Bolsons (Red Light, Green River, and Eagle Flat) Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Tapis cloud.data.exec tree contains mf2k.exe beside the West Texas Bolsons Red Light/Green River/Eagle Flat steady-state and transient namefiles.

resources.resource_name: Yegua-Jackson Aquifer GAM — Model
resources.evidence_basis: Explicit CKAN modflow_variant=modflow-2000 extra on the live package.
